items.title: Australia ratifies the High Seas Treaty
items.summary: Joining more than 90 other countries, the Australian Government has officially ratified the High Seas Treaty, (formally the Agreement under the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea on Conservation and Sustainable Use of Marine Biodiversity Beyond National Jurisdiction (BBNJ)).

items.title: Can businesses still meaningfully contribute to the Sustainable Development Goals?
items.summary: With a little over three years until 2030, the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) will not be met.

items.title: ON TUESDAY: What does a revised ISO 14001 mean for sustainability professionals?
items.summary: On 29 September, edie is hosting a webinar in partnership with BSI to explore changes to the ISO 14001 standard addressing environmental management.

items.title: Governments urged to unlock private investment as Europe faces €500bn climate resilience bill
items.summary: At Climate Week NYC, the Taskforce on Net Zero Policy (TNZP) has highlighted the importance of mobilising adaptation investment, with research showing that Europe could require €500bn to adapt through 2035.

items.title: ‘Concerning’ low sea ice persists as Antarctic hits third-lowest winter peak
items.summary: Antarctic sea ice has recorded its third-smallest winter peak extent since satellite records began 48 years ago, new data reveals.

items.title: Day 4 at Climate Week NYC: Governments and Business Focus on Climate Delivery
items.summary: Across New York, discussions moved from solar investment and building efficiency to sport, insurance and public trust.

items.title: ADM Plans 800,000-Ton Carbon Removal Credit Offering from Nebraska CCS
items.summary: ADM is preparing to enter the voluntary carbon dioxide removal market at significant scale.

items.title: Microsoft, PepsiCo Back Record 2,500-Truck Tesla Semi Order
items.summary: A coalition backed by major cargo owners including Microsoft and PepsiCo has placed the largest electric Class 8 truck order in U.S. history.

items.title: ERM, osapiens Partner to Turn ESG Compliance Data Into Business Action
items.summary: Sustainability consultancy ERM has partnered with digital ESG platform provider osapiens to help companies manage increasingly complex sustainability data and regulatory requirements.

items.title: ESB Raises $575 Million in Ireland’s First European Green Bond Deal
items.summary: DUBLIN, Ireland: ESB has raised approximately $575 million through its inaugural European Green Bond, becoming the first Irish corporate issuer to use the EU’s regulated green bond format.
